en.title: Load prebuilt static meshes in the model gallery
en.body: The gallery loads 22 meshes from one generated GLB. The fox and villager retain their live rigs. Model authors can regenerate the pack with node tools/bake-models.mjs --gallery.

zh.title: 模型画廊首开时直接加载静态网格
zh.body: 画廊从同一个 GLB 加载 22 个预生成网格，狐狸和村民继续播放实时骨骼动画。修改模型后可用 node tools/bake-models.mjs --gallery 更新模型包。
